title: PHerc0826 z [8928, 9728): what sets the First Letters recipe's winding spacing? Initial spacing and weight-decay sweep (2,000 steps)
notes: The First Letters recipe (tracks + Lasagna normals, dense spacing loss off) leaves windings about twice as dense as the sheets. With no loss on the spacing, the spacing may simply stay where it starts: villa's default model_initial_dr_per_winding is 16 voxels, with weight decay 0.01 on the gap expander. Four 2,000-step recipe fits change only that: initial spacing 24 and 32 voxels, weight decay 0, and initial spacing 24 without tracks. The 2,000-step recipe fit with the defaults is the seed fit S of notebook pherc0826-winding-model-supervision. Audit here: winding pitch and radius per winding only; the full audit (held-out agreement, CT checks, cross-sections) runs in the CPU audit notebook.
